meta.description: ICHU by SmartFarm: livestock monitoring with smart collars, herd records, and veterinary history.

terms.authentication: Sign-in is handled by Firebase Authentication. The ICHU API checks your account and ranch permissions before showing ranch data. Passwords are sent only to Firebase Authentication and are never stored by the application.
terms.records: ICHU stores collar telemetry and ranch records for each ranch, and shows them only to accounts with access to that ranch.
terms.preferences: Your selected language and ranch are stored in this browser.
terms.payments: Payments are processed by Stripe. ICHU never stores card data.
terms.contact: Contact SmartFarm about these terms or your data.

notFound.body: Check the address or return to your ICHU account.

login.title: Welcome back
login.note: Sign-in is checked by the ICHU account service.
login.navigationFailed: Your workspace could not open. Try again.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Full name
register.ranchDetailsNote: These details create your initial ranch account.
register.ranchDetailsRequired: Complete all ranch details and enter a positive whole number for herd size.
register.terms: I agree to the ICHU Terms of Use.
register.termsRequired: Confirm that you agree before continuing.
register.passwordNote: Your password is sent to Firebase Authentication and is never included in this review.
register.retryNotice: Account setup is not complete. Retry with the same email and password to finish it.
register.verifyNotice: Your account was created. Check your inbox for a Firebase verification email before signing in.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.lead: Enter the email address for your ICHU account.
recovery.note: If an account exists for this address, Firebase will send a password-reset email.
recovery.resultBody: If the address belongs to an account, a password-reset link is on its way.

errors.configuration: The application is not configured. Check the runtime settings.
errors.invalid-credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.email-already-in-use: An account already uses this email address.
errors.weak-password: Choose a stronger password and try again.
errors.email-not-verified: Verify your email address before signing in.
errors.account-unavailable: This ICHU account is unavailable. Sign in instead, or contact your administrator.
errors.service-unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.network: The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Authentication could not be completed. Try again.

account.title: My account
account.lead: Your verified identity, ranch access, and professional profile.
account.ranchesLead: Ranches your account can open, with the access you hold in each.
account.noRanchesBody: Your account does not have ranch access yet.
account.accessCodeHint: Share this code with your veterinarian so they can request access.
account.profileLead: Details saved for this veterinarian account.
account.editProfileLead: Changes are saved to your ICHU account.
account.profileRequired: Ranch access requests need a complete professional profile. Save your details below.
account.specialtyInvalid: Enter a specialty of up to 120 characters.
account.licenseNumberInvalid: Enter a license number of up to 80 characters.
account.yearsOfExperienceInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 70.

advisories.title: Herd advisories
advisories.lead: Veterinarians request access to a ranch here, and ranch managers review those requests.
advisories.requestLead: Find the ranch with its access code, then explain why you need access.
advisories.profileRequired: Complete your professional profile before requesting access.
advisories.accessCodeHint: Eight characters from the ranch manager's account page.
advisories.accessCodeInvalid: Enter the eight-character code from the ranch manager.
advisories.reasonInvalid: Explain why you need access, up to 1000 characters.
advisories.myRanchesLead: Ranches where your account already has access.
advisories.noMyRanches: You do not have ranch access yet.
advisories.requestsLead: Veterinarian requests for the ranch selected in the header.
advisories.noRanchBody: Access requests appear after your account is assigned to a ranch.
advisories.manageRequiredBody: Your access to the selected ranch does not include reviewing requests.
advisories.noRequestsBody: No veterinarian has asked for access to this ranch.

decision.title: Review access request
decision.lead: Choose the scope and last valid day to grant access, or reject the request.
decision.expiryInvalid: Choose a date from tomorrow onward.

advisories.revokeBody: The veterinarian loses access to this ranch until a new request is granted.

errors.configuration: The application is not configured. Check the runtime settings.
errors.unknown: The request could not be completed. Try again.
errors.http-403: Your account does not have permission for this action.
errors.http-404: The requested item was not found.
errors.http-409: This change conflicts with existing data. Refresh and try again.
